items.passage: And we hope to control this capex to INR80 crores, INR85 crores in the next year, that is '26-'27 as we will be going only for brownfield expansions now onwards.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: So by end of this financial year, that is '26-'27, probably we will be somewhere around 67,000, 68,000, maybe close to 70,000 tons.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: Yes. The volume growth is 10% to 13% because Pharma won't add volumes. It will hardly be in few tons. So volume-wise increment might look 10% to 13%, but value-wise increment, we are aiming at 13% to 15%.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: But in terms of value, I'm sure we'll be clocking between 13% to 15% value growth, like what we did this year, 13.3%. We hope that we will be somewhere between 13% to 15% in the value growth in the next financial year.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: That is why I said in the year '26-'27, we may cross the INR1,000 crores mark sales.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: I think we'll certainly be there. We are aiming at, at least INR210 crores EBITDA for next financial year, up from INR173, that's 20% price. I think we are definitely going to achieve that in view of not only the increasing business, but our internal improvisations and efficiency creation.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: you have guided going forward on maintaining around 20% growth rate in terms of profitability at EBITDA and PAT level. So are you maintaining that or is there any upside or downward revision? [...] I think we'll certainly be there. We are aiming at, at least INR210 crores EBITDA for next financial year, up from INR173.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: FY '27, as I expected, we are aiming at, at least 42 to 43, 42.5 could be a good estimate for the full year.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: '27-'28 may be a little difficult to predict now. Maybe we may touch even 45 given a good in Pharma. If it happens, we may aim at 44, 45 also for next '27-'28.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: Coming back to ROCE, yes, the ROCE has leaped by about 14% from 10.2% to 12.4% and probably it may hit around 13.5% to 14% in the next financial year.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: So probably the ROCE will start looking at around 15% by '27-'28.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: No, INR55 crores is our target for the next financial year '26-'27. We hit almost INR34.4 crores for the current financial year. So we have taken a 50% growth to reach somewhere around close to between INR50 crores and INR55 crores for the Pharma.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: If you combine the thick wall also, food is around 18%. But this 15.4%, I'm sure it will be looking at least 20% growth in the food and FMCG, including the North numbers for the next financial year.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: So going forward, that itself is indication that INR35 crores to INR40 crores of new addition in business can come from North in Qpack and Food together.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: Yes. Currently, Pharma is hardly about 1,500 tons, and we have to still make new investments in that segment to take it up to 2,500 tons in this year.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: And we are, in fact, adding 4 more machines in July for thin wall, so which will expand the capacity there by another 100%.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: It will become 2,000 tons Food and FMCG there. And Qpack also we're adding a little bit. So about 2,000 -- it will become 2,000 to 2,500 tons per annum, including Qpack.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: Sandeep Modi: So around Jan 2028, it will be operational fully? J. Lakshmana Rao: Yes, '27. '27, before end of the financial year, I think we may start the new plant because of the delay in land allotment.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director

items.passage: But these molds to become commercial and add revenues, it will certainly take 2 or 3 more quarters. So the numbers will start adding probably towards the end of this financial year, '26-'27.
items.speaker: J. Lakshmana Rao, Chairman and Managing Director
